thread:
Harper: Heads-up from Sales -> Meridian Labs (dedicated, eu-central). They've opened a ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/MER-5598 — reporting a latency tail after last night's maintenance. Dropping intake here for triage.
Noah: They report 95th percentile spikes up to ~650ms (their SLA 250ms). QPS steady ~6-9. Affected model: `clinical-small-quant-v2`.
Ravi: Release notes show runtime image bumped to runt-2.19 and a model variant swap to the quantized build. No routing changes. Will try to repro.
Zoe: Quick ask: can we get a scrubbed sample + token length distribution? Also, do we have a canary log from the deploy?
sales-ops: Customer provided a redacted sample: ``{"prompt":"List recent meds and doses for patient Z","max_tokens":220}`` Most requests 150-800 tokens, ~5% >1200.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy runt-2.19 completed by infra at 2026-04-02T01:18:43Z
Ravi: Hypothesis list: 1) quantized variant + KV-cache warmup behavior changed; 2) kernel selection fallback on long sequences; 3) autoscaler min-ready too low for new runtime. Will run a staged load that mirrors their token distribution.
Harper: Product recommends P1 (tedious SLA breach for a paying Dedicated customer). Proposed closure criteria: (A) root cause identified and remediation deployed OR rollback validated; (B) 95th percentile <= 300ms for 1 hour under comparable load; (C) customer updated every 60 mins until resolution. Agree?
Noah: Agreed. Also add: include a short mitigation note for support to send (what we tried + ETA). Sales asked for credits options if >24h.
Zoe: From eng side: rollback to runt-2.18 on that pool is likely fastest if we confirm repro on 2.19. Estimated canary + validation ~35m, full rollback ~40-60m after go. Config patch (preserve-kv-cache + bump min-ready) might be ~20-40m and less noisy. If it's kernel fallback, hotfix could be 3+ hours.
Ravi: Starting repro with 8 qps and token histogram. Will post flamegraphs, heap profiles, and a comparison between 2.18 and 2.19 within 40m.
Harper: Product asks eng to include a short runbook in the ticket: steps for canary rollback, impact on co-tenants, monitoring signals (p50/p95/kv-hit-rate/cold-start-count), and a checklist for customer comms. Also need a backlog item to add CI gating for quantized variants and long-tail seq tests.
qa-bot: Note: current CI suites do not cover quantized-variant long-seq scenarios. Raising ticket recommended.
Noah: I'll draft the initial customer update: ack + ETA 60m and mention possible rollback.
Ravi: Early repro note: p50 flat, p95 spikes map to nodes with low kv-hit-rate immediately after traffic shifts. Suspect KV preservation semantics changed in runt-2.19 for quantized stacks. Posting logs to ticket.
Zoe: If KV semantics are root cause, config flip to preserve cache + canary validation should restore SLA quicker than rollback and with lower blast radius. But we should still prepare rollback play.
Harper: Action items recap: Ravi -> repro/logs + recommendation; Zoe -> prepare rollback canary playbook and impact blurb; Noah -> customer comms & loop with sales; Harper -> create backlog ticket with acceptance criteria + CI gating request.
Ravi: Creating PROD ticket REDWOOD-MER-5598-HOTFIX now and linking artifacts. Will update in this thread once canary runs.
sales-ops: Customer acknowledged the update and asked for hourly status. :thumbsup:
Harper: Closing intake thread; continuing coordination in the PROD ticket.
